B.2.6 EH&S Safety concerns during surface preparation and cleaning arise due to the use of a number of dangerous acids and chemicals as well as high-pressure plumbing and piping systems and the potential use of oxygen- displacing asphyxiants like NO . Reducing hazards related to handling these chemicals and systems will 2 require administrative controls and procedures and training of staff on SOPs and emergency response behavior. Cleanrooms will need to be equipped with chemical eye and body rinse stations, fire extinguishers, acid/base neutralizers, and absorbents for chemical spills. All personnel should be equipped with personal protection equipment (PPE) including safety goggles, neoprene gloves, and protective body suits. While the chemicals used in these processes may also require specialized disposal, any firm utilizing acids, chemicals, or other hazardous wastes must have a hazardous waste disposal procedure in accordance with state and local laws. B.2.7 Commercial Considerations Wet cleaning and cleanroom capabilities are used in numerous industries beyond accelerators, including medical devices, semiconductor and space applications. Persys is a small company located near Silicon Valley that specializes in precision cleaning for new parts prior to their use in the semiconductor, magnetic, solar, optics, and aerospace industries. Their capabilities include CO2 and ultrasonic cleaning, as well as Class 10 cleanroom assembly capabilities with specific insight into refurbishment of semiconductor fabrication tools. Astropak one of the largest and most respected precision cleaning & surface treatment technology contractors in North America with locations in California, Florida, Texas and New Jersey. Astropak offers a wide range of processes including electropolishing, CO2 cleaning, precision cleaning and clean assembly which are primarily offered as turn-key services to customers. The BOA Group, German in sells ultra-clean, particle free flexible metal vacuum bellows which are used in semiconductor, optics, food and pharmaceutrical industries. Their capabilities include special processes for welding the bellows in a Class 100 clean room while final cleaning and packaging are performed in a Class 10 cleanroom. Space Dynamics Laboratory in North Logan, UT has extensive cleanroom assembly capabilities related to space satellites, including ultrasonic cleaning and CO 2 spray cleaning. These cleanroom and cleaning capabilities form a small segment of their much larger satellite assembly and testing capabilities. Finally, NTS-Group, Netherlands is a contract engineering and manufacturing firm which supplies primarily supplies the semiconductor market as well as the analytical and healthcare industries. These industries require specific attention to design for cleanliness and vacuum compatibility NTS offers numerous capabilities related cleaning this components. The above examples demonstrate that cleaning and cleanroom assembly capabilities are applicable to a broad range of markets, but are usually processes which are vertically integrated into the suppliers product line.
